$comment: Range controls of the native toolkit (#882): the slider and the spin buttons of the time fields. Taken from the current Settings, which is the spec: ui/lib/nidara-kit/slider.ts + rows.ts (NidaraSliderRow) and spinbutton.time-spin in ui/shell/styles/_components.scss. Final values require owner live review.
Default applies to every dark/reduceTransparency variant; variants override whole fields like list.json. Exported once as range in each components.json mode variant.

slider.source: NidaraSliderRow: width_request 140, the value label 12 px beside it; slider.ts: TRACK_H 6, THUMB_R 9 (drawn at r-1), accent fill at 0.9. Page Up/Down move 10 steps (#882's acceptance). Flanking icons (opts.icons): pixel_size 16 (iconSizes' default), opacity 0.5, in the row's 12 px spacing.

spin.source: spinbutton.time-spin: min-height 32, text min-width 28, buttons min-width 18, 1px border var(--nidara-border), radius sm; the two fields 4 px apart with a colon between (appearance.ts timePicker).
